outcome: neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: 19,831 singleton deliveries at or beyond 37 weeks' gestation without high-risk pregnancies or known fetal anomalies.
finding: Extending the second stage of labor by one hour in both nulliparous and multiparous women decreased primary cesarean delivery rates but was associated with an increase in operative vaginal deliveries and some maternal and neonatal complications, such as lower umbilical artery cord pH.
